case: T08 Native real expired stored session and protected same-owner recovery
limitations: The original expired token was consumed by the SDK before the fix; it was not reinserted.
Recovery used the retained cache after the SDK had removed the invalid session.
Initial owner outbox was empty. Expiry with pending/inflight operations was not tested.
Legacy provenance requires surviving matching owner-scoped caches.
Android, physical devices, full network loss and OAuth providers remain unverified.
